svg.title: NeoDEM architecture overview
svg.desc: One skill through the lifecycle. 1 Collect: teleop episodes are recorded on the robot-agent, and datasets can also be imported from the HF Hub. 2 Train: a worker claims a job from the server and moves data through RustFS. 3 Deploy: the server tells the agent to deploy, and the agent hot-swaps the adapter on vla-server. 4 Evaluate: the server spawns sim rollouts against the policy. 5 Operate: tasks go down, telemetry comes up, and inference runs closed-loop at the edge. 6 Comply: the agent ships audit logs and the server keeps them in Postgres. Open this file in a browser and click a stage to highlight its path.

g.title: Collect: teleop episodes are recorded as LeRobot v3, or imported from the HF Hub
Train: the worker claims a job, reads the dataset and writes a checkpoint
Deploy: the agent hot-swaps the LoRA adapter on vla-server
Evaluate: the server spawns sim rollouts against the policy
Operate: tasks, A2A chat, telemetry and closed-loop inference
Comply: the agent ships audit logs and the server keeps them
Teleop over a WebSocket straight to the robot-agent (keyboard, gamepad, VR), bound to a control lease
g.text: direct teleop WS, skips the server

g.title: The Quest 3 loads the app over USB adb reverse on localhost, the only origin WebXR accepts
REST under /api and one WebSocket at /api/a2a/ws
LLM calls: server CommandInterpreter and agent Genkit, HTTPS 443
Dataset import and browse from the Hugging Face Hub
Audit, compliance and system of record in Postgres (SQLite file in dev)
Job queues and KV on NATS JetStream (optional)
Datasets, checkpoints and models in RustFS / S3 (optional)
Push-model task distribution and A2A JSON-RPC conversations
The server proxies /vla/* to the agent, which loads the model
Telemetry over a WebSocket that the server dials, rebroadcast to the app
The server starts and stops recording on /api/v1/robots/:id/recording/*. The agent writes a LeRobot v3 dataset and reports each episode; interventions go to /api/datasets/interventions
ComplianceLogClient posts audit logs with the agent's service token
HTTP to the hardware sidecar
The same sidecar contract, served by the MuJoCo sim
SO-101 and voice sidecars
Unitree DDS for locomotion, odometry and LiDAR; ZMQ for state and cameras
Serial link to the SO-101 arm through LeRobot
VlaModelManager calls /load-adapter; SkillExecutor calls /predict in the closed loop
The worker polls the server to claim a job, then reports progress
The dataset comes in and checkpoints go out through S3
The server spawns evaluate_vla.py as a subprocess
Sim rollouts query the policy on vla-server
